citation.authors: Castagna A, Ferro Y, Noto FR, Bruno R et al

cited_by.title: Apple cider vinegar: weight, blood sugar and safety

record.population: Adults with overweight, obesity or type 2 diabetes in ten randomised trials of daily apple cider vinegar for at least 4 weeks
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised trials: body composition
record.finding: Daily apple cider vinegar reduced body weight, BMI and waist circumference slightly in the pooled results, with large differences between studies. Effects held when high-risk-of-bias trials were removed and were seen up to 12 weeks, at about 30 mL a day. The authors call it a possible short-term adjunct.
record.note: Short trials. Not a trial of lasting weight loss.
